summary: OpenAI published an internal customer-style story describing how a member of its own creative team uses Codex to build custom tools, generate campaign concepts, and prototype workflows.

practices.reason: The piece describes one employee's ad hoc use of natural-language requests to Codex to build UI prototypes, but gives no reusable technique, architecture or stated gain that a team could implement.
practices.quote: Using natural language, he can describe the workflow he wants and ask Codex to help build it.
